svg.title: Choose what backs the record.
svg.desc: Local verification checks journal and files against trusted inputs. An audited VM adds provider and access records. Optional Phala Intel TDX checks the quote, measured OS and application, and collector identity. Review these results together with the capture records and recorded coverage.

g.aria-label: One signed journal. Three deployment choices.
From Intel's root to the collected record.
Attestation verifies the measured collection environment and its recorded identity.
